annotations.title: Send Supabase phone codes over WhatsApp

description: Create or update the hook that lets a Supabase project send its phone sign-in and verification codes over WhatsApp instead of SMS. Supabase keeps making and checking the code; we deliver it. On Supabase Cloud, open Authentication → Auth Hooks, add a Send SMS hook of type HTTPS, and paste the answer's `record.url` and `secret`. If you host Supabase yourself, put `record.url` in `GOTRUE_HOOK_SEND_SMS_URI` and `secret` in `GOTRUE_HOOK_SEND_SMS_SECRETS`, then set `GOTRUE_HOOK_SEND_SMS_ENABLED: "true"`. The secret comes back ONCE, on the first save or when you rotate it; after a rotation the old one keeps working for 24 hours. Codes are metered under the API key that saves the hook. Each code is a normal message: it counts toward your quota, and the first code to someone the number has never talked to uses one of its new conversations for the day. Free to call.

numberId.description: The number codes are sent from. `null` uses your one connected number. Leave it out to keep the current choice.

rotateSecret.description: Mint a new secret and return it. The old one keeps working for 24 hours, while you update Supabase.

template.description: The message, with `{code}` where the code goes, e.g. "Your Acme code is {code}". `null` restores the default. Leave it out to keep the current one.
